quizzes.name: Closure Chronicles
quizzes.shortDescription: Master JavaScript closures by solving interactive puzzles across 10 levels covering scope, lexical bindings, private variables, and the module pattern.
quizzes.longDescription:
## Closure Chronicles

A hands-on JavaScript quiz that teaches closures, lexical scoping, and variable lifetimes through 10 interactive code puzzles.

### Features
- 10 progressively harder levels covering global, function, block, and lexical scope
- Interactive click-to-select answers with instant feedback
- Syntax-highlighted code blocks with a dark terminal aesthetic
- Detailed explanations after each level
- Hint system (costs one star)
- Mistake counter and 3-star rating per level
- Progress saved to localStorage
- Achievement badges for milestones (Flawless Run, Pure Knowledge, Closure Master)
- Final scorecard showing accuracy, mistakes, and completion time
- Confetti celebration on completion

quizzes.name: Command Line Craze

quizzes.longDescription:
## Command Line Craze

A retro-themed, interactive quiz to test your knowledge of essential command-line (shell/bash) commands. Features a terminal aesthetic with a dark purple/pink color scheme, scanlines, and glitch effects.

### Features

- 10 multiple-choice levels
- Retro terminal UI with animations
- Progress saved locally
- Instant feedback and final score

quizzes.name: CSS Selectors Challenge
quizzes.shortDescription: Test your CSS selector mastery by identifying targeted elements on visual DOM trees across combinators, pseudo-classes, and specificity.
quizzes.longDescription:
## CSS Selectors Challenge

An interactive quiz where developers are presented with CSS selectors and visual DOM trees to identify exactly which elements are targeted.

### Features
- 12 progressively challenging levels spanning basic selectors, compound classes, combinators, pseudo-classes, and attribute selectors
- Interactive visual DOM tree with clickable nodes and live match highlighting
- Live HTML rendered sandbox preview synchronized with the DOM tree
- Instant feedback with correct, incorrect, and missed element indicators plus detailed explanations
- CSS specificity breakdown for every selector
- Optional countdown timer mode with speed bonus points
- Persistent score tracking, streak multipliers, and accuracy stats saved via LocalStorage

quizzes.name: Dev Escape Room
quizzes.shortDescription: Escape themed programming rooms by solving interactive puzzles covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git, APIs, and JSON while unlocking new challenges.
quizzes.longDescription:
## Dev Escape Room

An immersive browser-based puzzle adventure where players escape themed programming rooms by solving real-world developer challenges. Each room introduces practical concepts through interactive tasks, debugging exercises, and logic puzzles.

### Features
- 6 unique escape rooms (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git, API, and JSON)
- Progressive difficulty with room unlocking
- Interactive coding, debugging, and logic-based puzzles
- Hint system with limited uses
- Timer, scoring system, and achievement badges
- Local progress saving using LocalStorage
- Responsive design for desktop and mobile devices
- Keyboard shortcuts and accessibility support
- Smooth animations and immersive game interface
- Final performance summary with completion time and score

quizzes.name: Event Loop Arena
quizzes.shortDescription: Master JavaScript's async execution order through 10 levels covering sync, setTimeout, Promises, async/await, and microtask priority.
quizzes.longDescription:
## Event Loop Arena

Predict the console output order of increasingly tricky JavaScript async code.

### Levels

1. Sync Basics
2. Variables First
3. setTimeout Intro
4. Timeout Delay
5. Promise Intro
6. Promise vs Timeout
7. Promise Chain
8. Nested Promises
9. async/await
10. Final Challenge

### Features

- Multiple choice prediction challenges
- Concept explanations after each level
- Score and star rating system
- Progress saved via localStorage
- Dark mode support

quizzes.name: Flexbox Mastery Gauntlet
quizzes.shortDescription: A visual, interactive quiz testing real-world CSS Flexbox mastery — main vs cross-axis alignment, flex-grow/shrink/basis calculations, auto-margins, and layout gotchas.
quizzes.longDescription:
## Flexbox Mastery Gauntlet

A visual, interactive quiz testing real-world CSS Flexbox mastery — main vs cross-axis alignment, flex-grow/shrink/basis calculations, auto-margin behaviors, and common layout pitfalls.

### Features
- 12 interactive levels spanning alignment, flex calculations, shorthand expansion, auto-margins, and layout debugging
- Live interactive mini CSS box preview alongside each question demonstrating alignment in real time
- Deep challenges covering flex-basis: 0 vs auto, align-items vs align-content, weighted flex-shrink math, and min-width: 0 overflow gotchas
- "Find the broken flex property" snippet debugging rounds
- Streak multipliers, synthesized Web Audio chime feedback, and instant CSS spec explainers
- LocalStorage progress, high score, and accuracy tracking

quizzes.name: JS Type Coercion Trivia
quizzes.shortDescription: Test your understanding of JavaScript type coercion through interactive multiple-choice challenges.
quizzes.longDescription:
## JS Type Coercion Trivia

Challenge yourself with JavaScript's most confusing type conversion behaviors. Predict the output of expressions, understand implicit and explicit coercion, and learn why JavaScript behaves the way it does through interactive trivia questions.

### Features

- 8–10 randomized questions per attempt
- Large question bank for replayability
- Instant feedback with detailed explanations
- Covers == vs ===, truthy/falsy values, NaN, typeof, implicit and explicit conversions
- Progress saved locally using localStorage
- Fully offline, single-file quiz
